svg.text: The same machine hosts more sessions
Isolated, a waiting agent still holds a process; Ollupi releases the slot while waiting, and another turn takes over
Letters are sessions; hatching is waiting
One VM or container per agent
One process, one shared execution pool
One process hosts only one session
A waiting process sits suspended, still holding memory
Scheduling state is in memory, lost when the process exits
Scheduled tasks need an external cron to start a process
One process runs every session, subagent and scheduled task
A waiting turn releases its slot and another turn takes over
Scheduling state is in SQLite; a restart resumes where it stopped
Scheduled tasks message a session when due and share the queue
